name: Pure Chess®
description:
Download Pure Chess® to experience chess the way it's meant to be played, in stunning 3D.

Experience one of the oldest known boardgames on the advanced technology of today. With ultra-realistic 3D visuals you can almost reach out and touch the pieces. Pure Chess® is a game that can be played by everyone, at any age, but mastered by only a few. The question is... Are you a Grandmaster in the making?
